This repo doesn't have a CMakeLists.txt (the build instruction in CLAUDE.md applies to the parent ast-tool project, not this evaluation fixture), so I'll skip the build step — the changes are straightforward signature updates verified by grep above.

Summary: updated `PaymentGateway::charge` and `PaymentService::authorize` (declarations + definitions) to take a `descriptor` parameter, threaded it through, and updated the two call sites with `"user_checkout"` (OrderService) and `"admin_bulk"` (AdminOrderService). `BillingGateway::charge` and both `refund` methods are untouched.
